name: The Royal Masquerade
source:
It's the night of the Royal Masquerade, but will a lowly scribe like you get to attend? Choose your House, change your fate, and pursue love in this romantic epic!

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Royal_Masquerade]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
这是皇家化装舞会之夜，但像你这样的卑微文士能参加吗？在这部浪漫史诗中选择你的房子，改变你的命运，追求爱情！

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Royal_Masquerade]Choices Wikia[/url]]
